text:
sara: heads-up — embeddings-prod started returning 502s at 09:12 UTC, seen across eu-west and us-east. impact: api/v1/embeds errors up ~18%. need a hotfix and expedited approvals. :rotating_light:
alex: ack. can you paste the smallest failing log snippet?
sara: from staging repro:
```ERROR kvcache: fail allocate key -> OOM building kvcache entry
  at runtime/kvcache.go:214
  context: buildKeySet size=8192
```
jay: i think pinning runtime to embeddings:v2.1-rc3 and lowering max_batch_tokens -> 1024 avoids the kvcache path. small change, low blast radius.
maria: fine with pin+batch reduction. what's the rollback plan if latency regresses?
jay: rollback plan: revert image tag to embeddings:v2.0, restore max_batch_tokens=4096, scale replicas down to previous target. i'll be standing by to execute revert.
devops-bot: deploybot: expedited deploy request received from @jay. Requires >=2 approvers or oncall override. Reply `approve` or react :thumbsup:.
sara: @oncall-ops this is user-impacting, please review perf sim.
oncall-ops: i'm here. running a quick perf sim with pinned image + lower batch. results: error-count drops, tail latency +4ms. i can approve for an expedited window.
releasebot: draft release note created: "hotfix: pin embeddings runtime to v2.1-rc3; temporarily reduce max_batch_tokens to 1024 to avoid kvcache OOMs. Monitoring QPS/latency post-deploy."
alex: ops runbook before deploy: 1) snapshot current RS and HPA, 2) pause autoscaler, 3) apply configmap hotfix, 4) apply image pin, 5) monitor p50/p95 and error-rate for 15m. i'll run 1-4.
jay: my manual deploy command:```./infra/deploy --service=embeddings --image=embeddings:v2.1-rc3 --config=embeddings-hotfix-1024.yaml --no-canary```
sara: can we skip canary to save time? change is low risk (pin + lower batch).
oncall-ops: approve expedited deploy. perf sim looks good.
alex: approve
maria: approve
devops-bot: deploybot: Approval threshold met (3 approvers). Locking autoscaler and annotating: `hotfix/1827654321-expedite`. Beginning runbook.
devops-bot: deploybot: step1 snapshot complete. step2 autoscaler paused. step3 applying configmap...
releasebot: reminder: will publish release note to /releases/hotfix-embeds-1827654321 on success.
alex: config applied, image pinned, kicking rollout now.
sara: watching dashboards — eu-west errors falling, us-east steady. p95 up ~10ms in peak but within SLO. :thumbsup:
devops-bot: deploybot: rollout reached 100% traffic. post-deploy checks: error-rate healthy, CPU stable, kvcache_saturation=false.
oncall-ops: good. watch for tail. if p95 > 200ms for 5m straight, trigger rollback per plan.
jay: i'll keep console open for 30m and can revert immediately if we see regressions.
maria: opening a short incident note and flagging CS for customer visibility.
sara: thanks team. i'll follow up with a short postmortem if we end up reverting. :heart:
